bindings.source: Existing 50 mesh registered BodyParts3D thorax; derived chest positions/landmark guides; external limb labels
bindings.patientOrientation: Patient-right/left, never viewer-right/left; lead RA/LA are electrode labels, not atria
bindings.polarity: Existing exact I/II/III and augmented step maps; caller cannot author arbitrary poles
bindings.rlQualification: Any visible RL “GND” is the existing module’s teaching shorthand: the right-leg electrode commonly provides a common reference/driven-right-leg function; it is not a positive/negative measurement pole or necessarily literal earth ground. The unused RA/LA/LL electrode is never reassigned as ground.
scopeLimits: No heart/lungs or full-limb/cable/device geometry in this thorax.
No contact-impedance, artifact, vector projection, reference-voltage or axis solver.
No computed tracing, strip/caliper amplitudes, diagnostic inference or automatically graded placement.
Ordinary runtime/state/quiz preservation and native browser/listening acceptance are separate adapter/integration checks.

M07.01.note: Electrode/cable/view distinctions and ten-electrode/twelve-view counts follow the approved adaptation. Cable hardware and measured electrical views are not rendered.

M07.02.note: Scientific correction: the unused RA/LA/LL electrode is not reassigned as ground for each bipolar lead, contrary to physical p250. Existing RL GND labels are teaching shorthand for a common reference/driven-right-leg function, not a measurement pole or guaranteed earth ground.

M07.03.note: Traditional unipolar terminology still requires a voltage comparison. Registered polarity annotations are static context, not calculated reference voltages or cutting-plane geometry.

M07.04.note: The sternal angle identifies rib2, then the second space immediately below it. Twelve PAIRS of ribs corrects the p31 shorthand. All 12 pairs exist in the source thorax; numbered instructional space overlays cover only 2nd–5th.

M07.05.note: Exact V1–V6 placement is an approved narration supplement supported by the existing registered Lead Placement Lab facts/anchors; it is not claimed to be fully spelled out in extracted p263 text. Locate V4 before V3 and keep V4–V6 horizontally level.

M07.06.note: Recording quality, color-standard variation and configuration differences are qualified explanations. No contact impedance, artifact generation, cable hardware or alternative validated electrode configuration is modeled.

M07.07.note: Approved correction: positive/negative deflection concerns net projection onto a lead, not a general rule that all electricity flows negative-to-positive; an isoelectric segment does not prove all cells inactive. No vector-to-trace solver is supplied.

M07.08.note: Approved correction to the p343 quadrant shortcut: Lead I positive/aVF negative includes0 to−30degrees; Lead II helps distinguish the borderline-normal region. No QRS amplitudes, axis computation or diagnosis is generated.
